description: Futures (leverage) facts from Binance perpetuals. symbol = one coin: funding per 8h (+ 30-day history and average; positive = longs pay shorts), open interest in USD with 24h/7d change, % of accounts long, and 'drive' = what is moving the price right now (spot_led = real buying, leverage_led = new futures bets while spot isn't buying, shorts_closing, shorts_piling, longs_flushed). No symbol = market: median funding, most crowded longs / shorts, biggest new and closing leverage among the top 60 futures markets. Facts, not forecasts (untested). Use for 'funding rate of X', 'is X crowded / overleveraged', 'open interest', 'squeeze'.

symbol.description: Optional coin symbol e.g. BTC. Empty = market view.
